package.name: web_mod
package.description: dorai demo dashboard. A headless-friendly web interface that subscribes to the voice_mod / stt_mod topics and renders a live view of the mic-array capture and beamformer output: per-mic level meters, raw-vs-clean spectrograms/waveforms, a streaming transcript, and per-mic drift/health diagnostics. Audio auditioning (raw vs clean) plays back through the robot's own speakers, so nothing but a browser is needed on the client side.
